text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0842 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.80 to C$1.30 lower on Monday's USDA crop production report which forecast soybean ending stocks at 125 billion bushels, many traders expected an increase. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -2.75 Friday from -3.08 Thursday. Canada's dollar was firmer at C$1.3912 against the dollar and fell to 85.22 yen and rose to 1.2196 marks. The Canadian currency lost eight percent of its value against yen since the beginning of May which could entice more Japanese import demand for canola.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.20 down in the July with pressure expected from allied markets and commercial demand at C$332/tonne in the July.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn, wheat calls on bearish sentiments based on the USDA's output report.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 lower on the USDA report and good seeding progress in Alberta.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
